name: Knoxland Equipment
old_description: Farmers, landscapers, property maintenance, construction contractors, and homeowners have counted on Knoxland Equipment since 1962 to be their one stop shop. We specialize in Mahindra Tractors, LS Tractors, as well as Ferris and Bad Boy Mowers. We also sell respected brands such as Briggs & Stratton, Land Pride, Hiniker, Milwaukee, and RedMax.
about:
Knoxland Equipment has operated from Warner, New Hampshire since 1962. The company serves as a dealership for agricultural and outdoor power equipment, offering sales, parts, and service from a single location.

The dealership carries tractors from Mahindra and LS, zero-turn and walk-behind mowers from Ferris and Bad Boy, and a range of implements and power tools from brands including Briggs & Stratton, Land Pride, Hiniker, Milwaukee, and RedMax. A service department provides repair and maintenance for all makes and models, handling everything from routine maintenance to major overhauls.

Customers include farmers, landscaping contractors, property-maintenance crews, construction firms, and residential homeowners throughout the region. The business has built its reputation on supporting both commercial operators and individual property owners with equipment suited to tasks ranging from field work to lawn care.

The company positions itself as a one-stop shop for equipment sales, parts, and service, emphasizing the ability to service all makes and models regardless of where the equipment was purchased.
